summary: Independent W4 review of the fresh frozen commit found no P0/P1. The rule12 fix adds one real installed-Conan-package cross-process workflow, counts it once, verifies persistence and processed records, and fails when required data or package payload is missing. Current local W3 and consumer evidence match source hashes and raw receipt bytes. Three nonblocking style/shared-baseline observations remain. Remote current-HEAD CI, human acceptance, merge, knowledge admission and publication are outside this local verdict.

verification.workflow_code_review: A fresh process imports the installed signed extension, writes a sync transactional sensor batch under a prefix, checks snapshot isolation, aborts a second transaction, deletes an obsolete record and closes the DB. A second fresh process imports the same installed package, reopens the DB, requires exactly two committed records and totals 40. The test checks both process return codes and distinct process IDs.
